messages:
Lena (PM): Quick decision thread: we need to lock the rollout pattern for the "tenant-windowed" approach on model-mix routing. Goal: low blast radius while letting sales opt a few tenants in. Short answers please.

Tao (Eng): Outline?

Lena (PM): Proposal: 3-dim rollout: time-windowed per-tenant cohorts, quota-bucket throttles, and overlap protection (no A/B & canary overlap on same tenant). Start with 10 tenants in week 1, +50 tenants week 2, then scale by telemetry.

Priya (SRE): Agree on overlap protection. We need a tenant lock that prevents two experiments routing the same traffic. Also require automatic rollback if any tenant's error-rate spike > 0.7ppt above baseline for 5m.

Omar (Product Ops): For partner opt-ins: sales list must provide activation windows and contact owner. We'll run a dry-run with QA-bot before enabling any tenant.

Nina (Sales): I'll collect 3 candidates: Orion, Sable, and Cluster9. They require timezone-aware windows (no launches during their business hours).

Tao (Eng): Technical constraints: routing config supports per-tenant window + token quota. We'll implement a `quota_bucket` with refill rate and burst capacity. If bucket exhausted, fallback to small-model or queue.

Lena (PM): KPI set for go/no-go: (1) p50/p95 latency delta < 15% over baseline, (2) model-quality regressions < 2% on eval prompts, (3) per-tenant customer errors < 0.5% increase, (4) cost delta per-1k tokens within budget band.

Priya (SRE): Add operational KPIs: fallback_invocations/min < 20, queue-length < 200ms median, alerting routes verified. Also require smoke-run of kill-switch within 30s.

Tao (Eng): Example flag schema we'll push:
```
flag: tenant_windowed_routing_v1
scopes: tenant
cohorts: [seed, ramp, global]
seed_tenants: ["orion", "sable"]
window_start: 2026-04-06T02:00:00Z
window_duration_min: 180
quota_bucket: {rate_per_min: 5000, burst: 2000}
overlap_protect: true
fallbacks: ["small_quant", "soft_rate_limit"]
```
Note: real storage will be key:value entries, just showing intent.

QA-bot: running dry-run for seed_tenants -> smoke tests queued.

Omar (Product Ops): Rollout calendar proposal: week 1 seed (10 tenants, 7-day observation), week 2 graded ramp (50 tenants), week 3 open beta (self-serve). Each step requires signoff from Eng+SRE+Sales.

Nina (Sales): For partner onboarding we'll require a short SLO addendum and a contact for 24/7 paging during the seed window. I'll get legal involved for EU data residency notes.

Tao (Eng): Implementation detail: overlap_protect means we tag tenant metadata with active_experiments list. Any attempt to enable a new experiment will fail if there's a clashing routing experiment. We'll expose an API to query tenant state.

Priya (SRE): Add runbook snippet: `if fallback_invocations > 30 in 5m => escalate pager -> consider immediate tenant rollback` and `if p95 > 400ms for 3 consecutive 1m buckets -> trigger auto-kill`.

Lena (PM): UX/A/B: we will not change downstream UI for seed tenants. For week 2 ramp we may enable a telemetry banner for participating customers. That's controlled by `ui_banner_sampling` flag (client-side).

Tao (Eng): Measurement hooks: annotate traces with `tenant_cohort`, `quota_bucket_state`, `fallback_reason`. We'll also emit a `routing_decision` event for every request.

Priya (SRE): Need a dashboard link and alert thresholds before go. Omar, can you publish the dashboard?

Omar (Product Ops): Working on dashboard: https://internal.redwood/dashboards/tenant-windowed-routing (draft). Will include cohort breakdown, per-tenant error-rates, quota consumption heatmap.

Nina (Sales): FYI, Orion requires us to avoid any EU->US cross-region fallback. Can we honor region strict mode per tenant?

Tao (Eng): Yes, add `region_strict` toggle per tenant. If enabled, fallbacks will be limited to same-region model pool. We'll document known capacity limits.

Lena (PM): Decision checklist to sign-off: 1) Feature flag + API ready, 2) quota buckets functional in load tests, 3) dashboard + alerts live, 4) runbook validated with kill-switch test, 5) sales partner list and legal reviewed.

Priya (SRE): I'll perform kill-switch test during the preflight and confirm in thread.

Tao (Eng): Load-test plan: simulate 100 tenants with burst profiles, validate quota enforcement and fallback correctness. I'll post results here.

QA-bot: dry-run smoke tests passed for orion and sable -> no crashes, fallbacks exercised.

Omar (Product Ops): Comms plan: embargoed release notes for partners + internal playbook. Postmortem template prepared.

Lena (PM): Who owns the final go/no-go by deploy window? We need a named approver.

Priya (SRE): SRE will own ops sign-off.

Tao (Eng): Engineering owner: Tao.

Nina (Sales): Sales owner: Nina (partner coordination).

Lena (PM): OK owners noted. Deploy window proposed by deploy-bot: 2026-04-06 02:00 UTC (seed only). If any sign-off missing at T-2h we auto-delay.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled 2026-04-06 02:00 UTC (seed cohort). Preflight check at T-3h.

Lena (PM): Final ask: react with :white_check_mark: if you accept the owner role. I'll collate and close at 18:00 PT.

Tao (Eng): :white_check_mark: Engineering owner.

Priya (SRE): :white_check_mark: SRE owner.

Nina (Sales): :white_check_mark: Sales owner.

Omar (Product Ops): :white_check_mark: Ops will publish dashboard.

Lena (PM): Thanks all. I'll convert this thread into the rollout checklist and link it when Omar's dashboard is live.

Omar (Product Ops): checklist draft: https://internal.redwood/rollouts/tenant-windowed-routing/checklist (draft) :page_with_curl:

Lena (PM): Closing thread. Post any late items in the checklist doc.
